sn20.3:1.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yānikānici kulāni bahutthikāni appapurisāni tāni supa dhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi.
sn20.3:1.3: evameva kho bhikkhave yassakassaci bhikkhuno mettā cetovimutti abhāvitā abahulīkatā so supadhaṃsiyo hoti amanussehi.
sn20.3:1.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yānikānici kulāni appatthikāni bahupurisāni tāni duppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi
sn20.3:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave yassakassaci bhikkhuno mettā cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā so duppadhaṃsiyo hoti amanussehi.
sn20.3:1.7: mettā no cetovimutti bhāvitā bhavissati bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhāti
